title: Recording: Husbands And Wives by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr continued recording ‘Husbands And Wives’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 20 August 1974.

This was the fifth recording session for the song. ‘Husbands And Wives’ was completed during a final overdub session on 1 October.
